title: Support and tools.
intro: Simple resources and educational content to accompany you through your process. Soma does not replace professional care.
quote: Asking for support is also a form of strength.

tools.title: Quick tools
tools.subtitle: Short exercises to use at your own pace.

breathing.title: Guided breathing
breathing.body: A visual guide to pace your breathing, without holding your breath.
breathing.rhythm: Suggested pace: breathe in for 4 s and out for 6 s.
breathing.notice: Breathe at your own pace. If you feel dizzy or uncomfortable, stop.

mindfulness.title: Mindfulness
mindfulness.body: Short pauses to come back to the present moment.

movement.title: Physical activation
movement.body: Gentle movement ideas for everyday life.

craving.title: Managing cravings
craving.body: Resources for riding out the urge to use.

learn.title: Learning resources
learn.subtitle: Educational articles already published in Explore.

processes.title: Key processes
processes.caption: How the body adapts to substance use.

audio.title: Audio and meditations
audio.caption: Soma does not have audio content yet.

strategies.title: Support strategies
strategies.subtitle: Short educational guides. Some are already available; others will be published after review.
strategies.sheetNotice: Educational content. Not therapy or medical care.
strategies.termsReference: Read the section on situations that need professional help

help.title: If you need help now
help.subtitle: Guidance for difficult moments.
help.educational: Soma is an educational resource. It does not provide professional assistance or emergency care.
help.emergency: If your life or someone else's is in immediate danger, contact the emergency services where you are.
help.professional: For personalised guidance, talk to a healthcare professional.
help.thirdParty: The links and phone numbers below belong to external services. Soma does not run those services and does not guarantee their availability or response.
help.termsLink: Read the section on situations that need professional help
help.otherEmergency: If there is immediate danger, contact local emergency services where you are. Soma does not provide an international emergency number.

coverage.label: Choose the resource coverage
coverage.hint: This choice only changes which list is shown. It does not detect your location.
coverage.empty: Select a coverage to see verified official resources.

plan.title: My support guide
plan.body: A short educational orientation. It is not clinical care and it is not a saved document.
plan.intro: Review these four sections at your own pace. The checkboxes are optional and only mark what you have read on this visit.
plan.privacy: Marks live only on this screen. They are not saved, not sent anywhere, and disappear when you reload the page. Soma does not ask for personal data here.
plan.optional: You do not need to tick anything to use the guide.

moments.title: Everyday moments for a pause
moments.body: There are ordinary situations when a short pause can help you regain pace: before a difficult conversation, when tension rises, or when the day piles up.
moments.hint: This is not an assessment of how you are. It is only an invitation to notice when a brief stop might help.

tools.title: Educational tools in Soma
tools.body: This Support centre includes short strategies on stress, emotions and habits, plus guided breathing.
tools.hint: They are educational materials. They do not replace therapy and they do not score whether you are «doing well» or «doing poorly».

people.title: People you trust
people.body: Talking with someone you trust outside Soma can be a form of support. Who that person is remains your choice.
people.hint: Do not enter names or phone numbers here. Soma does not store contacts and does not send messages to third parties.

professional.title: Professional help and emergencies
professional.body: When you need professional guidance or there is immediate danger, use the official resources in the help panel on this same page.
professional.hint: Self-care, trusted people, professional care and emergencies are different things. This guide does not replace any of them.
professional.linkHelp: Go to «If you need help now»
professional.linkTerms: Read the section on situations that need professional help
